'''Grizzled Edge Gauntlets''' is a {{gear|5|Gloves}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Hongshan Swordmancers and assembled by the AIC. This equipment can improve the wearer's combat capabilities.|A multi-functional piece of defensive equipment developed by Hongshan Swordmancers through the study of lost tech design documents. 
The supporting functions provided by this pair of gauntlets are slightly less than ideal. There are resources from the past that we could not replicate. This means our Tianshi must think of alternatives.}}
